title: Transformer-based SDSS search identifies two previously unreported optical–UV tidal disruption events
summary: A PCA-enhanced Transformer classifier screened 298,195 SDSS DR7 spectra and selected 14 TDE-like cases for secondary review. The authors report two newly identified TDEs: SDSS J124225.39+642919.0, whose GALEX UV source was present by the spectrum date (before 11 February 2002), and SDSS J152459.70+045423.1, whose TDE-H+He spectrum coincided with a Catalina optical outburst in 2007–08. The first is reported as the earliest optical–UV TDE then known; one other model-selected source was a previously reported likely TDE.
organization: University of Science and Technology of China; Purple Mountain Observatory; Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: A PCA-enhanced Transformer classifier screened 298,195 SDSS DR7 spectra and selected 14 TDE-like cases for secondary review.
evidence.unknown: The source is an arXiv preprint whose arXiv record says accepted by The Astrophysical Journal; no journal DOI was supplied in the source checked. The TDE classifications are supported by spectral and contemporaneous archival photometric evidence, not new contemporaneous follow-up observations. The event dates predate 2020, but this record uses the 2026 source-publication date for the since-2020 catalog period. The paper also reports a third previously known likely TDE, which is not counted as a new discovery.
evidence.ai_role: The Transformer classifier screened preprocessed SDSS galaxy spectra and selected TDE-like events for follow-up assessment. From roughly 298,000 spectra it produced 14 cases above the selection threshold; after checking spectral features against archival GALEX or Catalina variability and other diagnostics, the authors reported two previously unreported TDEs and one previously reported likely TDE. Reported test-set precision and recall were 0.88 and 0.99, respectively.
